hard_constraints: The Force behaves canonically for Legends: light and dark are natural moral-polar properties, and Force wounds remain wounds. 'The Weave' is era-specific language (project contract: force_mechanics.primary_rule).

Render Force through body-experience first, analysis second. Diagnostic vocabulary ('unweaving,' 'Weave') earned by experiential rendering (project contract: force_mechanics.sensory_vocabulary.concept_vs_sensation_rule).
Use rotation families for sensory vocabulary; avoid forbidden repeats like 'reached for the Force' (project contract: force_mechanics.vocabulary_variation.rules).
'Jedi' singular and plural; never 'Jedis' (project contract: canon_constraints.style_constraints).
Veraine introduces herself as 'Veraine,' dropping 'Darth' strategically (project contract: terminology_registry.Darth Veraine).
canon_risks: Sera's 'ancient containment protocols' and 'Force-containment field' must align with NSW-era Force-locks (AU extension of Legends stasis/Force barriers); avoid implying Inquisitorius structures.

Torin's 'void' as 'structured absence' (active technique: pulling/suction, practitioner as hungry void) must distinguish from passive unweaving (formless pressure) per force_mechanics.active_technique.
legends_continuity_notes: Brotherhood of Darkness (led by Lord Kaan, destroyed at Ruusan 1000 BBY) valid Legends faction; Veraine as alchemist/strategist fits wartime Sith specialists (Darth Bane novels).
Force wounds persistent (Nathema stripped by Vitiate ~5000 BBY; Malachor V via Mass Shadow Generator ~3960 BBY) – Torin's expanding void echoes these as engineered precedent.
Ben Skywalker: Jedi Knight post-Fate of the Jedi/Abeloth (47 ABY), GAG service under Jacen, experienced in Force anomalies.
required_context_for_drafter: Sera's containment: ancient Force-lock protocols adapted from stasis anchors (her expertise; same tech that sealed her). Professional discipline, not vengeance (scene_card.notes, anti_patterns).
Veraine contained: conscious, intellectually furious (detachment flaw; equations forming in fingers per chapter_blueprint.exit_vector).

Torin's void: active technique at full scale – structured violence, sharp boundary, practitioner as void/consuming structure (force_mechanics.active_technique; deliberate/directional vs. formless). Maetha's warning fragment: 'It replaces you.'
Resonance humming post-Veraine: warmth, living tissue, environmental wrongness lifted (force_mechanics.weave_resonance).
Setting: Veranthos valley/Scar epicenter – natural vergence, wound zone (full unweaving sensory: formless pressure, grief-without-object).
POV emotional arc: relief -> dread (Ben faces failure to save Torin).
allowed_au_divergences: Darth Veraine (Brotherhood alchemist, escaped anchor) existence and containment (concept_seed.conflict.primary_antagonistic_force).
Sera Varik (NSW Jedi, Force-lock expert) using stasis-derived protocols on Veraine (terminology_registry.Force-lock; ensemble_cast.Sera Varik).
Torin's technique deployment creating expanding void toward Scar (force_mechanics; canon_overridden.forbidden technique lineage).
Weave-Resonance containing wound via shared burden (no single load-bearing person) defeating Veraine (concept_seed.force_mechanics.implications).
open_questions: Does 'Force-containment field' risk overlap with Legends Force stasis precedents (e.g., carbonite variants or ysalamiri null zones)? Scene grounds in Force-locks/anchors.
